facts.fact: The state digital agency signed a three-year renewable agreement to host its data in the Nouakchott data centre, which the ministry's statement says holds a Tier III accreditation under international standards.

systems.owner: Mauritanian International Telecommunications company (as the agreement's counterparty)

MRT.note: The Tier III accreditation of a data centre is a certificate and places nothing; no membership, adoption or rule is stated.
The document does not state the data centre's ownership, so nothing on national ownership or the state's hosting with a national provider is recorded.
